description: This PHP file contains code for rendering the newsletter campaign creation wizard in SuiteCRM. It manages the user interface, including campaign details, target lists, trackers, subscription options, and navigation steps, utilizing Smarty templates, global variables, and relationships within the SuiteCRM framework.

classes.name: DotListWizardMenu
classes.description: Class responsible for rendering the dot list style wizard navigation menu

methods.name: create_newsletter_steps
methods.description: Defines the sequence of steps for the newsletter campaign wizard interface

methods.name: create_campaign_steps
methods.description: Defines the sequence of steps for the general campaign wizard interface

methods.name: create_email_steps
methods.description: Defines the sequence of steps for the email campaign wizard interface

methods.name: create_wiz_step_divs
methods.description: Generates HTML divs for each wizard step using Smarty templates

methods.name: create_wiz_menu_items
methods.description: Creates the navigation menu for the wizard, either as a dot list or table
